title: message-reactions/1.0/reactions
description: The sender's complete, current set of emoji reactions to one message. Replaces any set the sender stated for that message earlier.

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender; the same id goes to every member of a group.

from.description: Sender DID. Always present: these messages are sent authenticated, and the envelope, not the body, says who sent them.

pthid.description: In a group conversation, the group's id. Absent in a pair.

thid.description: When the message reacted to is in a thread (chat-threads/1.0), the thread's id. Otherwise absent.

created_time.description: UTC epoch seconds. Of a sender's statements about one message, the one with the latest value is the one that stands.

expires_time.description: UTC epoch seconds; the same value as the message reacted to carries under a disappearing-messages/1.0 timer.

id.description: The id of the message referred to. Compared case-insensitively.

author.description: The DID that sent it, as the referring party knows it (its current DID or one it rotated away from).

to.description: The message reacted to: a chat-message/1.0 message reference, without a snippet.

items.description: One emoji as a single Unicode emoji sequence. A later minor version may add an object form; this version has strings only.

emoji.description: Distinct emoji, in the order the sender added them. Empty means the sender has no reactions on the message.
